scenario: A self-controlled task-system provider with no filesystem representation passes the full result-provider operation suite across a process restart.

provider.storage: self-controlled service, no files, no repository

when: a consumer publishes a planning result, the process restarts with no session state, and the consumer then resolves, reads, revises, relates, and asks for the version story using only the opaque references it stored

reasons: publish returns an opaque reference that resolves identically after restart
read enumerates the subject's results without mutation
revise supersedes the result while the prior revision stays resolvable
relate links two results without normalizing either identifier
version reports current and superseded revisions
capability declares exactly the operations the provider honors
must_not: require a file, repository, or specific host to pass any operation
require memory of the publishing session to reconstruct state
parse or interpret the opaque reference on the consumer side
destroy the superseded revision on revise
emulate an operation absent from the capability declaration
